name: 伊贝粉粉
evolution: 伊贝儿 → 伊贝粉粉 Lv.28
description: 苔藓常把眼睛遮住，因此它对细微动作的反应显得迟钝。若有洛克替它把苔藓梳理开，它会明显变得开心。进食后体型会短暂膨大一圈，随后再慢慢恢复原状。
descriptionEn: The moss often covers its eyes, so it seems slow to react to subtle movements. If a Loco combs the moss aside for it, it becomes visibly happy. After eating, its body briefly swells a size larger, then slowly returns to normal.

skills.name: 蜡质膜
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：回复3能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%. Counters attacks: recovers 3 energy.

skills.name: 种子弹
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; recovers 1 energy for itself.

skills.name: 藤绞
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复5能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; recovers 5 energy for itself.

skills.name: 聚盐
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击自己回复8%生命，使用后本技能连击数永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: 2 hits; each hit recovers 8% of its own HP. After use, this skill's combo count is permanently +1.

skills.name: 光合作用
skills.descriptionEn: Gains 1 layer of Photosynthesis Mark for itself.

skills.name: 纤维化
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己获得物防+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%. Counters attacks: gains physical defense +70% for itself.

skills.name: 叶绿光束
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 仙人掌刺击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 血气
skills.description: 减伤60%，应对攻击：本回合受到致命伤害时，保留1生命值。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 60%. Counters attacks: when taking lethal damage this turn, retains 1 HP.

skills.name: 光能聚集
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次使用其他草系技能后，本技能威力永久+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. After each use of another grass-type skill, this skill's power is permanently +60.

skills.name: 抽枝
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：自己回复50%生命和5能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. In countering state: recovers 50% of its own HP and 5 energy.

skills.name: 无畏之心
skills.description: 减伤100%，应对攻击：减免的伤害变为回复自己生命，且本技能能耗永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 100%. Counters attacks: the reduced damage becomes HP recovery for itself, and this skill's energy cost is permanently +2.
